descriptionMarkdown:
This is an updated version of an older blueprint.

It crafts everything that is available on Nauvis except for science packs (over 140 different items in total)

Including belts, inserters, bots, ammunition, etc...

Constructive critique is appreciated ;-)

Input:

        90 iron ore per sec     
        60 copper ore per sec
        30 stone per sec
        30 coal per sec
        15 uranium ore per sec
        200 oil per sec
        water

I realised that it might be difficult to build that thing in one go especially in a new playthrough so I made a book that is more beginner friendly^^. Just overlay the blueprints while you progress.
title: Everything you need for Nauvis 2.0 Mall (Crafts over 140 items from ores to endproduct)
